description: Fixed natural-number parameters can be replaced by numerals without changing standard interpretation; this substitution preserves the existential bounded-prefix form.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.numerical_parameters {α β : Type}
  (A : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (α ⊕ β)) (p : β → ℕ) :
  ∃ B,
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.Defines (fun x => A.Realize (Sum.elim x p)) B ∧
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.BoundedSigmaOne A →
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.BoundedSigmaOne B)
